answer: Each identity must cross a tundra, crossed only on foot. Honest tundras are crossed over years; a farm's all on one road, one day. Every identity must carry a fable, a story only it knows. Honest fables are different tales; a farm's one story, copied word for word. Trust is dawn, light that arrives slowly and cannot be rushed. Honest dawns rise over many horizons; a farm's all rise at once, one lamp switched on, one hour. To pass, a farm must cross a real tundra, tell a real fable, and wait for a real dawn for every puppet.
